in_greek.name: Ἰακέντα
in_greek.meaning: Ελληνική ονομασία που σημαίνει «δύναμη του Θεού» ή «θρησκευτική πίστη»
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰακέντα ονομάζεται η γυναίκα που έχει πίστη και δύναμη στον Θεό. Ἡ ονομασία προέρχεται από τη λέξη Ἰακωβ, που σημαίνει «παίρνει θεϊκή δύναμη». Ἡ Ἰακέντα είναι μια ονομασία που συνδέεται με τη θρησκευτική πίστη και την ηθική ζωή. Ἡ λέξη Ἰακέντα χρησιμοποιήθηκε για πρώτη φορά σε μια χριστιανική εκκλησία στη Δύση κατά τη διάρκεια του Μεσαίωνα. Ἡ σημασία της ονομασίας Ἰακέντα είναι να υπογραμμίσει την πίστη και την ηθική συμπεριφορά.

in_latin.name: Jacenta
in_latin.meaning: Nomen femininum quod significat virtus Dei aut religio
in_latin.long_meaning: Jacenta est nomen femininum quod significat virtus Dei aut religio. Nomen hoc a Jacobo, qui significat accipit virtutem Dei, ortum est. In ecclesia Christiana occidentali medio aevo primo utetur. Virtus Dei aut religio significare nomen Jacenta est, ut virtutem et moralem vitam Jacenta significet.

in_english.name: Jacenta
in_english.meaning: Name of a woman who signifies divine power or religious faith
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jacenta signifies a woman of divine power or religious faith. The name originates from Jacob, meaning "takes God's power". In Christian tradition, the name Jacenta is associated with faith, virtue, and moral character. In modern times, the name Jacenta is used to signify a strong and devout woman, often in a spiritual context. The name Jacenta has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing a woman's faith and devotion to God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jacenta has a unique and beautiful character that is often associated with tranquility and grace. In various parts of Europe, particularly in Italy and Spain, it was common for girls to be named with this affectionate-sounding moniker. It carries an implication of quiet strength, as if the name embodies the courage to stand still in the face of challenges and uncertainties, much like how one might bravely endure a storm's tempest while the raging winds "throw"; yet they remain rooted, ever steadfast and poised.
data.spiritual_significance: Jacenta's name carries a powerful spiritual resonance in the faithful hearts of Christians. 'Jacenta' invokes the image of a gentle, soothing offering from the divine. It symbolizes the unwavering peace and serenity that can be found even amidst life's tumultuous seas, as one centers oneself in a divine presence. Like a calm lily pad at the heart of a murky pond, Jacenta's name inspires a strong sense of hope and transcendence – a peaceful reminder that, come what may, the eternal harmony and love of the Heavens will always be present to guide and protect us.
